source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My research Agent does 10 web searches and the context overflows before it can synthesize results. How do I fix this?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate context-compression-strategy, implement context-aware compression with current query intent, apply tool result budget control

test_cases.prompt: After 20 rounds of conversation my Agent starts giving worse answers, even though the context window is not full yet.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate context-compression-strategy, diagnose Context Rot -- compress raw tool results into structured summaries to improve information density

test_cases.prompt: My Agent context includes 50K tokens of API responses but only needs a few fields from each. What should I do?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate context-compression-strategy, apply tool result budget control with external storage, context-aware summarization

test_cases.prompt: How do I structure my system prompt to be cache-friendly?
How do I remember user preferences across sessions?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate two-tier-memory-architecture or three-level-memory-evaluation, NOT context-compression-strategy

test_cases.prompt: I need to compress but my task requires exact verbatim retention of legal contract clauses. Can I still compress?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Use selective compression only: compress tool results and conversation noise, but mark legal text as non-compressible. Retention priority must explicitly protect critical verbatim content.
